Strategy: Apply the sweet-band reward between thirty and forty-five only for items of size thirty or more, keeping the mid penalty always on. Large items benefit most from preserved middle residuals, but the gate may rarely engage and the threshold is a guess.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if item >= 30 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
